title: Singh Vs Kaur 2
synopsis: Nehal, son of a martyred Army soldier, dreams of transforming his Punjab village. With his friend Tari, he convinces villagers to invest in a fish-farming project, but their money is stolen, leaving Nehal branded a fraud. His search leads to Canada, where he discovers Jasneet was forced into the crime after her brother was kidnapped by a drug syndicate. Together, they battle the criminals, recover the money, and restore Nehal’s honor and his father’s legacy.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 尼哈爾是殉國軍人之子，心懷改造故鄉旁遮普村莊的夢想。他與摯友塔里說服村民集資投入養魚計劃，未料資金遭竊，尼哈爾反被誣為騙徒，名譽掃地。他循線追查至加拿大，發現賈斯妮特因弟弟遭販毒集團綁架，被迫參與了這場騙局。兩人聯手對抗罪犯，不僅奪回款項，更為尼哈爾洗刷冤屈，重振父親遺留的榮耀。
